purpose: Prevent episode truth, future observations, and same-group closure reports from entering runtime diagnosis while enabling design, causal log, and historical case research.

DESIGN_PUBLIC.notes: The same candidate design corpus must be available independently of episode truth.

OBSERVATION_CAUSAL.notes: No event, log, or summary after the diagnosis observation time is visible.

RESOLVED_CASE_TRAIN_ONLY.notes: The current provenance group can never retrieve its own closure report.

TRUTH_QUARANTINED.notes: Only an offline evaluator may access current labels, injection truth, future logs, and closure truth.

p0_acceptance: Contract models reject incoherent visibility and truth declarations.
Runtime access cannot be granted to TRUTH_QUARANTINED via caller tags.
Future observations are rejected by observation-time comparison.
Current-group closure reports are rejected before retrieval scoring.
Every rejection produces a stable reason code.
claim_boundary: This policy freezes document visibility and leakage prevention for development. It does not approve any document claim as runtime diagnostic evidence.
